definitions.source_asset_records: Asset records across the family manifests (one per source x file).
definitions.unique_files: Catalog entries: distinct SHA-256 values; exact duplicates across sources count once.
definitions.song_denominator: Songs of data/sources/song-index.json with in_original_game true (positive original-game evidence); Universe-only songs are outside it. Variants never multiply it.
definitions.song_art: A catalog gallery entry of kind song_art. It links a song only through its provenance records whose song_ids name that song, at their mapping_status; the merged song_ids alone link nothing. Confirmed song art: linked by a record whose mapping_status is confirmed_primary or confirmed_wiki.
definitions.with_any_artwork: Denominator songs with confirmed song art. Every per-song size, rendition, originality and illustrator metric below counts confirmed song art only.
definitions.inferred_only: Denominator songs without confirmed song art whose song_art links are all inferred.
definitions.conflict_only: Denominator songs without confirmed song art with at least one song_art link whose mapping_status is conflict (any other link inferred).
definitions.missing_art: Denominator songs without any song_art link. with_any_artwork + inferred_only + conflict_only + missing_art = denominator.
definitions.with_any_linked_asset: Denominator songs named by any catalog entry of any kind and any mapping status (screenshots included).
definitions.with_confirmed_original: Denominator songs with song art carrying one provenance record that is from the artists or official family, origin_status artist_post/official, mapping_status confirmed_primary naming the song, rendition site_original. Not a claim of an artist master.
definitions.with_long_edge_ge_1920: Denominator songs with confirmed song art whose decoded long edge is at least 1920 px; a size bucket only, not evidence of authenticity, full composition or a master.
definitions.low_resolution_only: with_any_artwork songs whose confirmed song art all have a long edge under 1920 px. best_long_edge buckets the songs by their largest confirmed song art (<1000, <1920, >=1920 px); a size bucket only.
definitions.rendition: Per provenance record: site_original when quality.source_variant is site_original and the record is not transformed; preview when source_variant is preview or transformed is true; else unknown.
definitions.with_site_original: with_any_artwork songs with confirmed song art that has a site_original record (the file as the source serves it at full size; not a claim of an artist master).
definitions.variant_unknown: with_any_artwork songs without a site_original record but with an unknown one.
definitions.preview_only: with_any_artwork songs whose confirmed song art records are all previews or platform transforms. with_site_original + variant_unknown + preview_only = with_any_artwork.
definitions.unknown_illustrator: with_any_artwork songs whose confirmed song art all have an empty illustrators list.
definitions.unknown_illustrator_assets: Catalog entries of artwork kinds (not screenshots or references) whose merged illustrators list is empty.
definitions.unmapped_assets: Catalog entries of artwork kinds whose provenance records are all unmapped.
definitions.conflict_assets: Catalog entries with at least one provenance record whose mapping_status is conflict.
definitions.inferred_only_assets: Catalog entries with an inferred record and no confirmed one (an entry that also has a conflict record is listed in conflict_assets too).
definitions.source_reported_mismatches: Records where an advertised SHA-1, byte count, size or MIME differs from the saved bytes (comparison false); null comparisons are not mismatches.
definitions.staged_site_estimate: What scripts/prepare_pages.py stages, counted the same way: one original per SHA-256 (the file named by the url of each catalog entry with site_original true; identical copies under other sources' paths and archive-tier originals stay out), each distinct preview named by a thumb, and the generated data/catalog.json, data/catalog.js, index.html (null when it is not rendered: no template outside the repository root) and data/coverage.json (this file, LF line ends). It excludes the static page files prepare_pages also stages (archive.html, README*, LICENSE, NOTICE, .nojekyll, assets/site/, docs/, licenses/, src/, ...), so editing them never makes this report stale; prepare_pages enforces the exact budget.
definitions.successor_not_primary: Records whose superseded_by names a record that is not the primary (catalog ID) of its catalog entry; catalog_entry is the entry holding the successor's bytes.
